faq_heading: Mission Townhomes for Sale: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Mission townhomes for sale: ground-level homes in strata buildings. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for townhomes in Mission was $618,000 in September 2026 (-4.1% over a year). Before you offer, read the strata documents: the depreciation report, meeting minutes, bylaws and fees.
Mission townhomes sold, November 2025 to October 2026

65 townhomes sold in Mission with a median price of $679,900 (the middle half sold between $635,000 and $709,900), taking a median of 25 days to sell at 98.6% of the last list price; 3% sold above list. They had a median $444 per square foot, a median year built of 2021 and a median strata fee of $349 a month.

blocks.text: Before you buy townhomes in Mission
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What did townhomes in Mission sell for?
faq.a: 65 townhomes sold in Mission between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $679,900.

faq.q: How long do townhomes take to sell in Mission?
faq.a: The median was 25 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 98.6% of the last list price (3% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most townhomes in Mission sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 65 townhomes that sold in Mission went for between $635,000 and $709,900, around a median of $679,900.

faq.q: Do townhomes in Mission sell above asking price?
faq.a: 3% of the 65 townhomes sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 98.6% of it.

faq.q: What is a typical strata fee for townhomes in Mission?
faq.a: Of the 65 sales, 64 listings gave a monthly fee and the median was $349.

faq.q: How old are the townhomes that sold in Mission?
faq.a: The median year built was 2021 for the 65 townhomes sold in Mission.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do townhomes in Mission usually have?
faq.a: The median townhome that sold in Mission had 3 bedrooms, from the 65 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Mission communities sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Mission BC (55), Mission-West (9), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Which Mission buildings sold the most townhomes?
faq.a: By number sold: Skyview (10), Archer Green (8), Spencer Estates (5), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What is the benchmark price of a townhome in Mission?
faq.a: The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for townhomes in Mission was $618,000 in September 2026, a modelled price for a typical home and not an average of sales.

faq.q: Did townhome prices fall in Mission?
faq.a: Over the past year the benchmark fell 4.1%. Over three months it fell 4.3%. A change under 1.5% is not described as a rise or fall.

faq.q: Is Mission a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Mission had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many townhomes are for sale in Mission?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the townhomes in Mission that match what you want.
